title: Artificial Leviathan: Exploring Social Evolution of LLM Agents Through the Lens of Hobbesian Social Contract Theory
abstract: arXiv:2406.14373v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) and advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) offer an opportunity for computational social science research at scale. Building upon prior explorations of LLM agent design, our work introduces a simulated agent society where complex social relationships dynamically form and evolve over time. Agents are imbued with psychological drives and placed in a sandbox survival environment. We conduct an evaluation of the agent society through the lens of Thomas Hobbes's seminal Social Contract Theory (SCT). We analyze whether, as the theory postulates, agents seek to escape a brutish "state of nature" by surrendering rights to an absolute sovereign in exchange for order and security. translated_title: 人工利维坦：透过霍布斯社会契约论的视角探索大语言模型智能体的社会演化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的出现和人工智能（AI）的进步为大规模计算社会科学研究提供了机遇。在先前LLM智能体设计探索的基础上，我们的工作引入了一个模拟的智能体社会，其中复杂的社会关系会随时间动态地形成和演化。智能体被赋予心理驱力，并被置于一个沙盒式的生存环境中。我们通过托马斯·霍布斯的开创性社会契约论（SCT）的视角对智能体社会进行评估，分析是否如该理论所假设的那样，智能体会试图通过将权利让渡给一个绝对的君主以换取秩序与安全，从而逃离野蛮的“自然状态”。我们的实验揭示了两者的契合：起初，智能体陷入不受约束的冲突之中，这与霍布斯对自然状态的描绘如出一辙；然而，随着模拟的推进，社会契约逐渐涌现，从而导致……
tldr: 该论文构建了一个赋予心理驱力的LLM智能体沙盒模拟社会，并以霍布斯社会契约论为分析框架，实验发现智能体从最初类似“自然状态”的无序冲突逐步演化出社会契约，为计算社会科学验证社会理论提供了新范式。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a sandbox society of psychologically-driven LLM agents and evaluates it through Hobbes's Social Contract Theory, showing that agents evolve from unrestrained conflict resembling a "state of nature" to the emergence of social contracts.
